classification.countable_rule: excludes optional ingredients, water, salt, black pepper, and cooking oils
classification.notes: Effort: Steady prep (1); garlic chips and sear need periodic attention, the braise is unattended (1); adobo plus rice (1); sear and reduce-to-glaze (1); one braiser plus set-and-forget rice (0). Sum 4 -> moderate. WAVE proposed easy; the sear-plus-glaze method and rice side score moderate under the rubric (legacy-Easy drift avoided). Long braise clock does not raise effort. Complexity: 8 countable (whole peppercorns counted as pepper, a freebie; 9 if counted, still band 1 -> sum 1, simple). No specialty: distilled white vinegar is the default, cane vinegar optional. One soy-vinegar profile (0). Sum 0 -> simple. Filipino cuisine adds no points.
